q: Radioactive pollution is the result of released radionuclides in the ____.
e: Radioactive pollution is the result of released radionuclides in the environment. Environment is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: A radionuclide is an atom with an unstable nucleus which has excessive ____.
e: A radionuclide is an atom with an unstable nucleus which has excessive energy. Physical state changes still move energy even though the substance stays the same chemically.

q: Radioactivity is a spontaneous process of decay or disintegration of heavy nuclei generating different types of radiation such as alpha particles, beta particles and gamma ____.
e: Radioactivity is a spontaneous process of decay or disintegration of heavy nuclei generating different types of radiation such as alpha particles, beta particles and gamma rays. Radioactivity is when an unstable nucleus throws out alpha, beta, or gamma radiation to lose energy.

q: These radiations including X-rays are called ____ radiation.
e: These radiations including X-rays are called ionising radiation. Ionising is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Alpha particles can be blocked by a few pieces of ____.
e: Alpha particles can be blocked by a few pieces of paper. Paper is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Beta particles pass through paper but are stopped by aluminium ____.
e: Beta particles pass through paper but are stopped by aluminium foil. Foil is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Low energy beta particles may penetrate the superficial layer of skin, whereas high energy beta particles will penetrate the skin a centimetre or ____.
e: Low energy beta particles may penetrate the superficial layer of skin, whereas high energy beta particles will penetrate the skin a centimetre or more. More is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Gamma rays are the most difficult to stop and require concrete, lead, or other heavy shielding to block ____.
e: Gamma rays are the most difficult to stop and require concrete, lead, or other heavy shielding to block them. Them is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Gamma rays and X-rays can cause severe damage to the ____.
e: Gamma rays and X-rays can cause severe damage to the cell. Cell is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The majority of background radiation occurs naturally from minerals and a small fraction comes from man-made ____.
e: The majority of background radiation occurs naturally from minerals and a small fraction comes from man-made elements. Background radiation is the ionising radiation that is already around you from rocks, air, and space.

q: Naturally occurring radioactive minerals in the ground, soil, and water produce background ____.
e: Naturally occurring radioactive minerals in the ground, soil, and water produce background radiation. Radiation is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Cosmic radiation from space also contributes to the background radiation around ____.
e: Cosmic radiation from space also contributes to the background radiation around us. Background radiation is the ionising radiation that is already around you from rocks, air, and space.

q: A trace amount of radionuclides, uranium and thorium, are naturally found on the ____.
e: A trace amount of radionuclides, uranium and thorium, are naturally found on the Earth. Earth is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Traces of radioactive materials can be found in the body, mainly naturally occurring potassium-____.
e: Traces of radioactive materials can be found in the body, mainly naturally occurring potassium-40. 40 is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The radioactive gas, radon, can be found at higher levels in the air in houses and other buildings, as well as in water from underground ____.
e: The radioactive gas, radon, can be found at higher levels in the air in houses and other buildings, as well as in water from underground sources. Sources is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Prolonged exposure to radon gas can cause lung ____.
e: Prolonged exposure to radon gas can cause lung cancer. Cancer is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Uranium-235, americium-241, and plutonium-239 are fissile materials produced from a breeder ____.
e: Uranium-235, americium-241, and plutonium-239 are fissile materials produced from a breeder reactor. Reactor is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Ionisation smoke detectors use americium-241 as a source of alpha ____.
e: Ionisation smoke detectors use americium-241 as a source of alpha particles. Particles is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Alpha particles from the americium source ionise air ____.
e: Alpha particles from the americium source ionise air molecules. Molecules is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: There is no health threat from ionisation smoke detectors as long as the detector is not damaged and used as ____.
e: There is no health threat from ionisation smoke detectors as long as the detector is not damaged and used as directed. Directed is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: A well-known use of carbon-14 is radiocarbon dating which can be used to date wooden and organic objects, especially in ____.
e: A well-known use of carbon-14 is radiocarbon dating which can be used to date wooden and organic objects, especially in archaeology. Archaeology is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Uranium-235 is used as fuel for nuclear power plants and naval nuclear propulsion ____.
e: Uranium-235 is used as fuel for nuclear power plants and naval nuclear propulsion systems. Systems is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Caesium-137 is used as a tracer in medical radiation therapy devices for treating ____.
e: Caesium-137 is used as a tracer in medical radiation therapy devices for treating cancer. Cancer is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Caesium-137 is also used in industrial gauges that detect the flow of liquid through ____.
e: Caesium-137 is also used in industrial gauges that detect the flow of liquid through pipes. Pipes is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Radioactive reactors use fissile heavy atoms as fuel instead of fossil ____.
e: Radioactive reactors use fissile heavy atoms as fuel instead of fossil fuels. Fuels is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Nuclear bombs are weapons having massive destructive ____.
e: Nuclear bombs are weapons having massive destructive power. Power is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The explosion of a nuclear weapon releases a combination of heat, blast waves and ____.
e: The explosion of a nuclear weapon releases a combination of heat, blast waves and radiation. Radiation is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Radionuclides found in water are potassium-40, radium-226 and radium-____.
e: Radionuclides found in water are potassium-40, radium-226 and radium-228. 228 is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Water bodies are also polluted by accidental leakage of waste material from uranium and thorium mines, nuclear power plants and ____.
e: Water bodies are also polluted by accidental leakage of waste material from uranium and thorium mines, nuclear power plants and industries. Industries is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Radioactive materials can enter the human body through water and food and may be accumulated in blood and certain vital ____.
e: Radioactive materials can enter the human body through water and food and may be accumulated in blood and certain vital organs. Organs is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Accumulated radioactive materials cause tumours and ____.
e: Accumulated radioactive materials cause tumours and cancer. Cancer is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.
